segments.an5.223:1.3: Bahubhaṇḍo hoti bahubhaṇḍasannicayo, bahubhesajjo hoti bahubhesajjasannicayo, bahukicco hoti bahukaraṇīyo byatto kiṃkaraṇīyesu, saṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena, tamhā ca āvāsā pakkamanto sāpekkho pakkamati.
segments.an5.223:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā atinivāse.
segments.an5.223:2.3: Na bahubhaṇḍo hoti na bahubhaṇḍasannicayo, na bahubhesajjo hoti na bahubhesajjasannicayo, na bahukicco hoti na bahukaraṇīyo na byatto kiṃkaraṇīyesu, asaṃsaṭṭho viharati gahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena, tamhā ca āvāsā pakkamanto anapekkho pakkamati.
segments.an5.223:2.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā samavatthavāse”ti.

lines: Pañcame raho nisajjāya āpajjatīti “yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyan”ti imasmiṃ sikkhāpade (pāci.290) vuttaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
Paṭicchanne āsane āpajjatīti “yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena raho paṭicchanne āsane nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyan”ti imasmiṃ vuttaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.

Mātugāmassa uttari chappañcavācāhi dhammaṃ desento āpajjatīti ‘yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmassa uttari chappañcavācāhi dhammaṃ deseyya aññatra viññunā purisaviggahenā”ti (pāci.63) evaṃ vuttaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
